title: Stable FIFO Publication Queue Retrofit
owner_directive: Replace racing publication leases with a stable ordered queue so lanes reserve main in turn, prepare/reconcile/validate only when their turn activates, publish once, then release to the next reservation.
reproduced_failure: UISR-08 required repeated stale-base reconciliations while concurrent product lanes published.
UISR-09 required stale-base reconciliation after concurrent MNCS publication.
UISR-10 required reconciliation/revalidation while concurrent lanes advanced main.
Repeated publication rewriting/revalidation consumed execution time without adding product value.
implementation: OPERATING_CONTRACT v3.3.0 defines FIFO reservation, turn activation, turn_base ownership, post-activation preparation/validation, exact-head merge, and release.
BOOTSTRAP publication instructions point to FIFO reservation rather than race/rebase behavior.
ops3_merge_lease.py schema 2.0 models queue reservations, active turn, turn_base, validation binding, release, cancellation and yield.
Control-plane regression tests prove FIFO ordering and that queued lanes cannot activate or pre-bind candidates out of turn.
UISR-10 execution conformance corrected to record multi-Continue/stall-nudge incidents.
